name: @oh-my-opendsh/fixture-lsp-double-project
description: P6-T5 e2e fixture workspace for the hermetic LSP double. The package.json exists so the vendored engine's findWorkspaceRoot (patches/omo-dsh/vendor/lsp-core/src/lsp/client-wrapper.ts:23 WORKSPACE_MARKERS) stops at THIS directory — it is the LSP rootUri / root the double is spawned against, and it keeps the fixture out of the repo's own workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml globs only patches/omo-dsh/* and patches/omo-dsh/vendor/*).
